reviewer: Assistant visual review; provisional judgments, not an independent human gold standard. One shared grade per query/image for both variants.

rubric.2: Main entity and explicit conditions visibly match
rubric.1: Main content related but condition missing, contradicted or uncertain

notes.V01: Rank 1 is the previously confirmed black cat, so the black-dog error remains. Dark gray poodle is partial under black-coat condition.
notes.V02: First two cats are beside a window. Original 001675 is a cat on a laptop; original 014007 is on a refrigerator, with no window visible.
notes.V03: Walking with umbrella on wet/rainy streets matches; stationary man on dry pavement is partial. Plural phrasing is treated as an activity description, not an exact person count.
notes.V04: Kitesurfing is related but board type ambiguous; body surfing does not establish balancing on a surfboard. Standing surfers on waves match.
notes.V05: All five show parked motorcycles outdoors; original 498709 inspected to confirm outdoor street context.
notes.V06: Green/white bus bodies match. Yellow/silver buses, blue buses and uncertain yellow-green color at sunset are partial.

notes.V08: First two sit on bicycles. Motorcycle is not bicycle; standing beside bicycles and a partial foreground bicycle do not confirm sitting on one.
notes.V09: First two are white airplanes in blue sky. Parked airliner, red aerobatic airplanes and aircraft against gray cloud are partial. Kites and ski jumping have no airplane.
notes.V10: Original 460494 confirms a fork beside the red meal plate. Clock with decorative cups is unrelated. A dessert on a stone serving plate is partial for meal.
